messages:
jen: heads-up, viewers reporting black screen for the live all-hands and captions lagging ~20s. @video-team any eyes? :loud_sound:
mark: seeing encoder errors on the dashboard, looks like frame drops around 15:18. pulling logs now.
mark: logs: ```encoder-3 WARN frame_drop count=5 interval=12s
encoder-3 ERROR reconnecting to ingest```
priya: can we switch to backup ingest? last time that worked without interrupting audio. Gabe, can you prepare DNS flip?
gabe: prepping backup route. will coordinate a 30s window to switch. also requesting cam SD cards from stage ops.
ops-bot: Incident logged IN-2024-421: all-hands stream degraded (video) -> paging video-team.
emma: starting local OBS capture as precaution: profile allhands_local, recording to /tmp/allhands_local.mp4. cmd: `obs-cli --startrecording`
zach: checked NDI, cam feeds OK but keyframe gap observed. possible stage switcher network hiccup.
leo: leadership wants to keep Q&A live if audio is stable. propose slide: "Video degraded — proceeding audio-only" and continue.
jen: agreed. putting up slide now and posting note to participants.
mark: doing DNS swap in 5...4...3... swapped to backup ingest. monitoring stats.
mark: backup ingest accepted stream, bitrate normalizing. can folks confirm video restored? :eyes:
emma: I see video returning on the hosted player, local recording file growing. starting checksum when done.
priya: still missing a 90s snippet around 15:18-15:20 on the hosted archive. can we pull camera SDs to fill gap? Gabe?
gabe: stage ops hands over cam1 SD now. copying to s3://allhands-raw/1749001234/cam1/ (upload in progress).
leo: i'll stitch emma's local + cam1 once copy finishes. ETA 20m. will produce a short clip for product and post in channel.
mark: left full encoder logs at s3://infra-logs/allhands/1749001234/encoder.log (video-team perms granted).
priya: action item: enable automatic local-recording for future all-hands so fallback is always available.
ops-bot: Action created: TICKET-ALLHANDS-52 "Enable automatic local-record fallback" assigned to ops.
zach: suggestion for next run: overlay a heartbeat "last keyframe: Xs" to spot frame stalls earlier.
jen: noted for postmortem. thanks everyone for quick switch and running audio-only while we recovered. will share final stitched clip and follow-ups when ready.
emma: if anyone needs raw local file before stitch, ping me and I'll drop to the shared bucket.
leo: stitched clip uploaded to https://storage.redwood.ai/allhands/1749001234/stitched-clip.mp4 with brief notes.
jen: received, closing thread after doc updates created. :white_check_mark:
